entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I... I need to return my VeloBand. I know it's been a little over two weeks, and I feel terrible about it.

I can certainly look into that for you. I see here you received the band 16 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, no, the band is fine. It's just... we had a major family emergency right after it arrived. My father had to be rushed to the hospital for unexpected heart surgery.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he's doing okay.

He's recovering, thank you. But with that, and my brother's upcoming military deployment, I just completely lost track of everything. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really, really needed this money back for bills. I feel awful for missing the window.
Please, don't worry about it. Family comes first, and that sounds incredibly stressful. Let me just pull up our official policy here... one moment please.
Okay, I've got it. Actually, you have nothing to be concerned about. Our return policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery.
Ninety days? Really? I thought it was something like 10 or 15 days. Are you sure?

I'm positive. It says right here in my system: 10 days for the VeloBand GPS Tracker. Since you're only on day 16, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund. No exception is even needed.
Oh, wow. That is... that's a huge weight off my shoulders. Thank you so much, Alex. I was so worried.
Of course, I'm glad I could clear that up for you. I'm generating your prepaid return label now and it will be sent to the email address on file. You should see it within the next 10 minutes.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you.
You're very welcome. I wish your father a speedy recovery and all the best to your brother on his deployment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better rest of your day.
